laws.title: global-model persistence
laws.statement: One selected model index remains fixed over the complete evaluated trajectory.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: probability conservation
laws.statement: Every transition row and initial distribution sums exactly to one.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: envelope order
laws.statement: The exact lower envelope never exceeds the corresponding upper envelope.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: rectangular containment
laws.statement: For one fixed policy, the rowwise rectangular lower value does not exceed the global-model lower value.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: gap nonnegativity
laws.statement: The defined global-minus-rectangular fixed-policy gap is nonnegative.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: terminal base
laws.statement: Horizon zero returns the declared terminal vector.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: discount-zero immediacy
laws.statement: At positive horizon and zero discount, transitions do not affect the current reward value.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: policy census
laws.statement: Two actions across n states produce exactly 2^n deterministic stationary policies.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: relabel covariance
laws.statement: A bijective state relabel preserves scalar envelopes and optimal-policy value sets.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: model deletion monotonicity
laws.statement: Removing an admissible global model cannot reduce a lower envelope.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: tie nonerasure
laws.statement: Every exact optimal policy tie is retained before selecting a display representative.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: initial-mass conservation
laws.statement: The initial distribution remains normalized under all read-only transformations.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: rational closure
laws.statement: All finite computations remain in reduced exact rational form.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: invalid-subject nonpromotion
laws.statement: A successful refusal never promotes its malformed subject.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

laws.title: authority nonpromotion
laws.statement: Synthetic computation never supplies empirical, participant, legal, cultural or production authority.
laws.scope: project hypothesis checked only across fifteen frozen synthetic profiles

boundary: Finite synthetic same-owner mathematical and software evidence. No empirical GMUT confirmation, production THOS or Freed ID, independent reproduction, real participant evidence, identity, consciousness, personhood, professional, legal, cultural, affected-party or Maori authority, complete privacy or accessibility, exhaustive security, AGI, ASI or Theory-of-Everything proof.
